user.title: Connect an Afterglow phone
user.description: Enter the phone's LAN hostname or IP, or paste its HTTP base address. A port in the pasted address takes priority. HTTP credentials are optional when disabled on the phone.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: The address must identify the same Afterglow installation.

reauth_confirm.title: Update phone credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Use the HTTP access credentials configured on the phone.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to a compatible Afterglow API. Check the address, running service and network.
error.invalid_auth: The phone rejected the HTTP username or password.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different Afterglow installation.

abort.already_configured: This phone is already configured. Its connection information was refreshed if needed.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered phone could not be verified.
